art_direction: 银刃晴街：27岁成年原创女性，银白短狼尾、紫晶眼睛、柔方鹅蛋脸与英气眉眼，钴蓝街头外套、完整白T恤与工装裤，电青天空、绯橘台阶和酸橙黄点缀形成高饱和撞色。
composition_variation: Head-to-upper-thigh street-fashion portrait, slight stepping turn, one hand at jacket collar and the other in trouser pocket, confident near-frontal gaze and clean sky above.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved outside the repository in Codex task artifact directory jewel-electric-street/native. Canonical wallpaper is cropped and resized.

retouch.method: Local color-mask cleanup of generated pseudo-lettering on dark shoulder trim; replaced only letter pixels with matching dark fabric color.

wallpaper.hair: Pearl-silver short layered wolf cut with blue-violet shadows
wallpaper.title: 银刃晴街 · 电青绯橘
wallpaper.visual_review_notes: Inspected compressed full wallpaper and shoulder-detail contact sheet after cleanup. One adult original woman, silver layered short wolf cut, purple eyes and a confident expression. Coherent hand holding jacket collar and other hand in trouser pocket, opaque blue jacket and white shirt, saturated blue-orange-lime palette. Pseudo-lettering on shoulder trim removed locally. No unwanted people, text, watermark or evident anatomical defects.

visible_description: 银白短狼尾、紫晶眼睛的成年女性身穿钴蓝外套与白T恤，一手提衣领、一手插袋，电蓝晴空、绯橘台阶和酸橙黄细节衬出利落英气。
